title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
why_it_matters: Canonical PD-disaggregation system and one of the clearest TTFT/TPOT goodput framings.
limitation: Mostly studies phase split; operator-level AFD is outside scope.

title: Splitwise: Efficient Generative LLM Inference Using Phase Splitting
why_it_matters: Early and influential argument for serving prefill and decode on different hardware tiers.
limitation: Static phase-splitting model does not cover newer AFD/MoE operator splits.

title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Turns KV cache into the central disaggregation primitive and releases production-style traces.
limitation: KV-centric phase disaggregation; not a full AFD system.

title: ShuffleInfer: Disaggregate LLM Inference for Mixed Downstream Workloads
why_it_matters: Studies interference between heterogeneous inference workloads under disaggregated serving.
limitation: The earlier TetriInfer preprint has a ShuffleInfer archival version; inspect the selected version before reusing claims or configurations.

title: MemServe: Context Caching for Disaggregated LLM Serving with Elastic Memory Pool
why_it_matters: Explores elastic memory pooling for context reuse in disaggregated serving.
limitation: Primarily state-centric rather than operator-centric.

title: LoongServe: Efficiently Serving Long-Context Large Language Models with Elastic Sequence Parallelism
why_it_matters: Shows long-context serving stresses static placement and motivates elastic execution.
limitation: Sequence-parallel long-context serving is adjacent to, not identical with, AFD.

title: P/D-Serve: Serving Disaggregated Large Language Model at Scale
why_it_matters: Studies practical issues in scaling PD-disaggregated serving.
limitation: Does not address attention/FFN operator disaggregation.

title: DejaVu: KV-cache Streaming for Fast, Fault-tolerant Generative LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Makes KV streaming and fault tolerance first-class serving concerns.
limitation: Not focused on MoE or AFD.

title: Llumnix: Dynamic Scheduling for Large Language Model Serving
why_it_matters: Dynamic migration and scheduling are important building blocks for elastic disaggregation.
limitation: General serving scheduler rather than a dedicated disaggregation architecture.

title: MegaScale-Infer: Serving Mixture-of-Experts at Scale with Disaggregated Expert Parallelism
why_it_matters: Foundational system paper making attention/FFN and expert disaggregation concrete at production scale.
limitation: Relies on static provisioning and strong communication assumptions.

title: Step-3 is Large yet Affordable: Model-System Co-design for Cost-effective Decoding
why_it_matters: A production-oriented AFD design paired with an open communication library.
limitation: Model-specific co-design; the linked StepMesh artifact is its communication library, not a complete serving reproduction.

title: StepMesh: A High-Performance, Low-Latency Communication Library for Attention-FFN Disaggregation
why_it_matters: One of the clearest open-source communication substrates built specifically for AFD.
limitation: Library-level artifact; end-to-end serving claims depend on integration.

title: JANUS: Disaggregating Attention and Experts for Scalable MoE Inference
why_it_matters: Extends the attention/expert disaggregation line beyond MegaScale-Infer.
limitation: Open questions remain around dynamic placement, jitter, and multi-rack behavior.

title: Efficient MoE Inference with Fine-Grained Scheduling of Disaggregated Expert Parallelism
why_it_matters: Targets scheduling inefficiencies inside disaggregated expert-parallel inference.
limitation: Builds on the DEP premise rather than resolving when DEP should be used.

title: Injecting Adrenaline into LLM Serving: Boosting Resource Utilization and Throughput via Attention Disaggregation
why_it_matters: A partial-AFD design that offloads attention work to improve utilization.
limitation: Offloading ratio and synchronization costs remain difficult to generalize.

title: Analytical Provisioning for Attention-FFN Disaggregated LLM Serving under Stochastic Workloads
why_it_matters: Provides an analytical framework for A/F ratio provisioning under stochastic workloads.
limitation: Theory needs broader validation under real systems, online adaptation, and fabric constraints.

title: Revealing the Challenges of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Modern MoE Models and Hardware Systems
why_it_matters: Important boundary study showing when AFD fails due to communication and imbalance.
limitation: Primarily analysis; mitigation remains open.

title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
why_it_matters: Production-scale MoE inference reference that motivates AFD and DEP designs.
limitation: System details are only partially public.

title: DeepEP: An Efficient Expert-Parallel Communication Library
why_it_matters: Widely referenced communication substrate for large MoE inference.
limitation: Communication primitive, not a full serving policy.

title: SARATHI: Efficient LLM Inference by Piggybacking Decodes with Chunked Prefills
why_it_matters: Core counter-argument that co-located chunked prefill can avoid disaggregation overhead.
limitation: Does not separately provision memory-heavy and compute-heavy resources.

title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
why_it_matters: Strong production-style baseline against PD disaggregation.
limitation: Does not expose an A/F provisioning knob.

title: Prefill-Decode Aggregation or Disaggregation? Unifying Both for Goodput-Optimized LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Argues that aggregation and disaggregation should be unified rather than treated as binary choices.
limitation: AFD-specific operator split is not the main target.

title: Towards High-Goodput LLM Serving with Prefill-decode Multiplexing
why_it_matters: Strengthens the case that smart multiplexing can compete with physical disaggregation.
limitation: Not designed for MoE attention/FFN separation.

title: Nexus: Proactive Intra-GPU Disaggregation of Prefill and Decode in LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Shows disaggregation can be logical or intra-GPU, not only physical inter-node separation.
limitation: Different cost model from rack-scale PD or AFD.

title: FlowKV: A Disaggregated Inference Framework with Low-Latency KV Cache Transfer and Load-Aware Scheduling
why_it_matters: Targets the state-transfer bottleneck that constrains PD and AFD systems.
limitation: KV transfer improvement does not alone solve operator provisioning.

title: CacheGen: KV Cache Compression and Streaming for Fast Large Language Model Serving
why_it_matters: Compression and streaming are essential when disaggregation turns KV into network traffic.
limitation: Focuses on KV cache rather than broader split decisions.

title: LMCache: An Efficient KV Cache Layer for Enterprise-Scale LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Makes cache reuse a reusable serving layer.
limitation: AFD integration remains an open design question.

title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with CachedAttention
why_it_matters: Shows conversation-level cache reuse changes serving economics.
limitation: Disaggregated placement is not the main focus.

title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion
why_it_matters: Connects cache reuse with RAG serving, a workload class that stresses disaggregated state.
limitation: RAG-specific; not a general AFD system.

title: Stateful Large Language Model Serving with Pensieve
why_it_matters: Frames long-lived state as a first-class serving primitive.
limitation: Does not resolve attention/FFN provisioning.

title: RAGCache: Efficient Knowledge Caching for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
why_it_matters: Important adjacent work for cache-heavy serving workloads.
limitation: RAG-centric rather than disaggregation-centric.

title: Infinite-LLM: Efficient LLM Service for Long Context with DistAttention and Distributed KVCache
why_it_matters: Long-context serving amplifies the need for distributed KV and attention-side design.
limitation: Long-context attention focus; not directly AFD.

title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
why_it_matters: Baseline runtime and memory-management foundation for modern LLM serving.
limitation: Originally not designed around physical PD or AFD separation.

title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
why_it_matters: Important open runtime for modern high-throughput serving and MoE deployment practice.
limitation: Not itself a single disaggregation paper.

title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
why_it_matters: Foundation for iteration-level scheduling and continuous batching.
limitation: Predates most PD and AFD work.

title: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation and Automatic Sharding
why_it_matters: Foundational sparse-model and sharding work behind later MoE serving systems.
limitation: Training-oriented compared with modern serving papers.

title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
why_it_matters: Popularized simple sparse expert routing at large scale.
limitation: Model architecture focus; not a serving system.

title: DeepSpeed-MoE: Advancing Mixture-of-Experts Inference and Training to Power Next-Generation AI Scale
why_it_matters: Early system substrate for MoE training and inference at scale.
limitation: Not designed around attention/FFN disaggregation.

title: Tutel: Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts at Scale
why_it_matters: Important MoE system substrate for expert-parallel execution.
limitation: General MoE substrate rather than AFD policy.

title: FastMoE: A Fast Mixture-of-Expert Training System
why_it_matters: Earlier MoE system work that informs expert-parallel communication.
limitation: Training-oriented and earlier than current serving constraints.

title: Accelerating Distributed MoE Training and Inference with Lina
why_it_matters: Bridges MoE training and inference communication optimization.
limitation: Not an AFD-specific serving design.

title: Frontier: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate LLM Inference Simulation
why_it_matters: Extended simulator comparing colocated, PD, and AFD deployments with explicit computation and communication models.
limitation: The extended version replaces the earlier workshop entry; predictions still require target-runtime, workload, and fabric calibration.
aliases: Frontier: Simulating the Next Generation of LLM Inference Systems

title: BurstGPT: A Real-World Workload Dataset to Optimize LLM Serving Systems
why_it_matters: Workload traces are needed to evaluate static versus adaptive disaggregation.
limitation: Trace availability does not by itself define a benchmark.

title: SpotServe: Serving Generative Large Language Models on Preemptible Instances
why_it_matters: Shows serving placement must handle unreliable and heterogeneous resources.
limitation: Not specific to PD or AFD.

title: SPAD: Specialized Prefill and Decode Hardware for Disaggregated LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Represents the hardware specialization side of the disaggregation argument.
limitation: Specialized hardware assumptions may not transfer to general GPU clusters.

title: Beyond the Buzz: A Pragmatic Take on Inference Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Useful skeptical baseline for claims that disaggregation always wins.
limitation: Broad perspective; not a full AFD boundary theory.

title: Revisiting Disaggregated Large Language Model Serving for Performance and Energy Implications
why_it_matters: Studies performance and energy tradeoffs for PD-disaggregated serving; throughput improvements need not imply energy savings.
limitation: Energy-optimized AFD remains open.

title: Libra: Flexible Request Partitioning and Scheduling for Serving Unbalanced and Dynamic LLM Workloads
why_it_matters: Partitions requests at flexible token boundaries and schedules cooperating micro-requests across unified GPU instances.
limitation: Canonical NSDI 2026 follow-up to DynaServe; distinguish request partitioning from fixed prefill-only/decode-only pools.

title: Vidur: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework For LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Provides a profiled operator simulator and deployment search framework for serving experiments.
limitation: AFD, network congestion, and new architectures require explicit extensions and calibration rather than assumed support.

title: Mélange: Cost Efficient Large Language Model Serving by Exploiting GPU Heterogeneity
why_it_matters: Treats GPU selection as workload- and SLO-dependent cost allocation, useful for fair heterogeneous-serving baselines.
limitation: Heterogeneous allocation is not itself a phase or operator disaggregation policy.

title: How Far Can Disaggregation Go? A Design-Space Exploration of Attention-FFN Disaggregation for Efficient MoE LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Compares AFD with chunked-prefill and P/D baselines across context lengths, prefix reuse, and latency constraints.
limitation: Evidence combines measured kernels with network simulation; validate conclusions on the target fabric.

title: AFD-Ledger: Deployment Provisioning for Attention--FFN Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Jointly provisions AFD and collocated deployments under matched workload, TPOT, hardware catalog, and budget.
limitation: Offline provisioning with bounded validation does not establish online elasticity or robustness to arbitrary workload shifts.

title: Rethinking Heterogeneous System Disaggregation for Subquadratic Attention
why_it_matters: Splits decode around quadratic versus subquadratic attention resource demands rather than attention versus FFN alone.
limitation: Hardware-proxy and analytical results need separate treatment from measurements on a deployed heterogeneous platform.

title: A Shape-Adaptive Architecture with Disaggregated Quantization for Efficient LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Co-designs shape-adaptive execution and phase-specific quantization for changing prefill and decode batches.
limitation: Custom accelerator design is not a drop-in GPU serving runtime or a cluster scheduling baseline.

title: Towards Load-Aware Prefill Deflection for Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Deflects prefill onto decode-side slack while protecting active decodes, avoiding KV transfer for those requests.
limitation: The reported DeepSeek-V2-Lite cluster evaluation does not establish the same behavior for large MoE or AFD.

title: FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Combines bounded prefill offload with in-place worker role reassignment to address transient and sustained imbalance.
limitation: Recent preprint; compare adaptation overhead, decode SLO protection, and workload sensitivity before generalizing.

title: Analytical Power-Aware Provisioning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated AI Inference
why_it_matters: Models serving-capacity and average-power Pareto fronts including input/output distributions and KV reservations.
limitation: Analytical provisioning is distinct from validated online DVFS, AFD control, and full-cluster energy measurement.

title: Disaggregated Quantization: Specializing LLM Prefill and Decode
why_it_matters: Specializes prefill/decode compute formats, weights, and storage placement and evaluates accuracy under disaggregated serving.
limitation: Additional weights and KV compatibility introduce memory, loading, and quality constraints; not all variants use separate GPUs.

title: Disaggregated Prefill and Decoding Inference System for Large Language Model Serving on Multi-Vendor GPUs
why_it_matters: Studies compatible KV transmission and joint parallelism/instance allocation across different GPU vendors.
limitation: Vendor-specific transport compatibility and deployment assumptions must be checked for each device pair.

title: SmartGen: Seamless Disaggregated LLM Inference with Selective KV Cache Transfer
why_it_matters: Overlaps proactive, on-demand, and speculative KV transfer to reduce the initial handoff barrier on limited networks.
limitation: Selective availability and model accuracy require validation; transfer-engine gains do not determine end-to-end SLO goodput.

title: NetKV: Network-Aware Decode Instance Selection for Disaggregated LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Adds network cost to decode-instance selection instead of using cache locality and compute load alone.
limitation: Reported evaluation is simulation-based; congestion telemetry and production overhead need independent measurement.

title: SpectrumKV: Per-Token Mixed-Precision KV Cache Transfer for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Allocates per-token KV precision and probes model tolerance to reduce transfer payload while retaining important tokens.
limitation: INT4 tolerance is model-dependent and lossy policies need quality evaluation alongside latency.

title: Lynx: Progressive Speculative Quantization for accelerating KV Transfer in Long-Context Inference
why_it_matters: Starts decoding from an anchor bit stream and verifies speculative progress after residual precision arrives.
limitation: Verification, rollback, and transfer overlap must be included when evaluating latency and output equivalence.

title: Efficiently Serving Large Multimodal Models Using EPD Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Separates multimodal encode, prefill, and decode stages and studies allocation and changing workloads.
limitation: Encode-stage memory, transfer payloads, and modality mix create additional constraints beyond text-only P/D.

title: vLLM-Omni: Fully Disaggregated Serving for Any-to-Any Multimodal Models
why_it_matters: Introduces a stage graph and connectors for independently serving autoregressive and diffusion components of any-to-any models.
limitation: Stage-level job-completion gains are not directly comparable to text-only TTFT/TPOT or AFD results.

title: EPD-Serve: A Flexible Multimodal EPD Disaggregation Inference Serving System On Ascend
why_it_matters: Combines stage orchestration, feature prefetching, and hierarchical KV transfer for multimodal serving on Ascend.
limitation: Ascend topology and co-location behavior need revalidation on GPU-based serving stacks.

title: EAServe: Encode-Aware Disaggregated Serving for Multimodal Large Language Models
why_it_matters: Uses encode-aware admission, partial prefill offload, and resource search to balance an EPD pipeline.
limitation: Results depend on modality mix, encode batching, and SM sharing; isolate these effects from the benefit of disaggregation.

title: Helix Parallelism: Rethinking Sharding Strategies for Interactive Multi-Million-Token LLM Decoding
why_it_matters: Reuses the same GPUs for KV-parallel attention and tensor/expert-parallel FFN, providing a temporal alternative to spatial AFD.
limitation: Targets long-context interactive decode; distinguish temporal sharding changes from dedicated attention/FFN worker pools. The linked runtime contains an implementation; follow its version-specific feature guide.

title: NVIDIA Dynamo
why_it_matters: Distributed serving framework with separate prefill/decode workers, routing, and deployment tooling.
limitation: Backend, connector, and deployment support are version-specific; this is a framework rather than a single paper.

title: NVIDIA Inference Xfer Library (NIXL)
why_it_matters: Pluggable inference data-transfer layer used by disaggregated serving and storage integrations.
limitation: Transport primitives do not implement a request scheduler, cache policy, or complete P/D service.

title: llm-d
why_it_matters: Kubernetes-native inference stack with reproducible deployment paths for P/D, KV reuse, and expert parallelism.
limitation: Requires compatible platform and backend components; an installation guide is not a portable performance guarantee.

title: TensorRT-LLM
why_it_matters: NVIDIA runtime with disaggregated-serving and parallelism implementation guides, including Helix.
limitation: Model, GPU, precision, and feature combinations must match the documented release.

title: AIPerf
why_it_matters: Client benchmarking toolkit with latency metrics, load control, and documented BurstGPT replay.
limitation: Length-only trace replay synthesizes prompts and does not reproduce original semantic prefix reuse.

title: KVDirect: Distributed Disaggregated LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Decode workers pull prefill-owned KV blocks over rail-aligned RDMA; prefill frees after completion.
limitation: Decode-initiated KV pulls optimize a specific RDMA data path; report rail topology, registration, and achieved transfer bandwidth.

title: OME: Revolutionizing LLM Infrastructure with Model-Driven Architecture
why_it_matters: Documents engine (prefill), decoder and router components on Kubernetes; KV from engine to decoder.
limitation: Kubernetes engine/decoder/router orchestration is not a standalone inference kernel implementation.

title: Ray Serve: Prefill-decode disaggregation
why_it_matters: Documents prefill and decode deployments; prefill KV handed via connector metadata.
limitation: Documented serving pattern with backend-specific KV connectors; pin Ray, engine, and connector versions together.

title: Introducing AMD ROCm Infera: Scaling Goodput for Agentic AI with Distributed Inference Orchestration
why_it_matters: Role-registered prefill and decode engines on MI355X; KV handed off by PD connector, host kvd tier.
limitation: ROCm deployment/runtime compatibility and backend transport matter; vendor-reported improvements need matched hardware/workload checks.

title: LAPS: A Length-Aware-Prefill LLM Serving System
why_it_matters: Prefill tier split by prompt-length class within SGLang PD; KV handoff inherited from SGLang.
limitation: Current primary title is LAPS; prompt-length separation refines prefill scheduling rather than introducing an A/F operator cut.

title: AlignedServe: Orchestrating Prefix-aware Batching to Build a High-throughput and Computing-efficient LLM Serving System
why_it_matters: Prefill offloads KV into a host-memory pool where requests await prefix-aligned decode batching.
limitation: Prefix-aware batching and host KV pooling affect iteration bubbles; evaluate cache semantics and transfer cost together.

title: DualPath: Breaking the Storage Bandwidth Bottleneck in Agentic LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Prefill and decode engines with hit-token KV read from 3FS storage via both sides' I/O paths.
limitation: Storage I/O balancing is distinct from faster compute; report storage/NIC budget, cache-hit workload, and exposed data movement.

title: semi-PD: Towards Efficient LLM Serving via Phase-Wise Disaggregated Computation and Unified Storage
why_it_matters: Prefill and decode compute partitioned on shared GPUs; unified KV storage shared by both roles.
limitation: Unified storage avoids some copying but still needs explicit ownership, synchronization, access-path, and memory-capacity accounting.

title: RAPID-Serve: Resource-efficient and Accelerated P/D Intra-GPU Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Prefill and decode processes share GPUs via CU masks; weights and paged KV shared through IPC.
limitation: Intra-GPU spatial separation shares memory/weights; its resource and transfer costs differ from separate-node PD.

title: Taming the Chaos: Coordinated Autoscaling for Heterogeneous and Disaggregated LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Prefill and decode on heterogeneous GPU pools with coordinated autoscaling; PD state crosses between pools.
limitation: Coordinated autoscaling mixes phase ratio, heterogeneous placement, and topology; measure each mechanism and adaptation delay.

title: HexGen-2: Disaggregated Generative Inference of LLMs in Heterogeneous Environment
why_it_matters: Prefill and decode placed on heterogeneous GPUs by graph partition and max-flow; KV routed over mixed links.
limitation: Heterogeneous PD depends on achieved KV-transfer bandwidth and scheduling; a hardware mix alone is not a fair cost comparison.

title: ThunderServe: High-performance and Cost-efficient LLM Serving in Cloud Environments
why_it_matters: Heterogeneous cloud GPU groups designated prefill or decode; 4-bit KV queued for decode retrieval.
limitation: Cloud/network heterogeneity and planning matter; inspect phase placement and billing alongside serving goodput.

title: Prefill-as-a-Service: KVCache of Next-Generation Models Could Go Cross-Datacenter
why_it_matters: Compute-dense prefill clusters serve remote PD clusters; hybrid-model KV crosses datacenters.
limitation: Cross-datacenter viability is tied to smaller hybrid-model state; traditional dense KV payloads need their own crossover analysis.

title: TokenScale: Timely and Accurate Autoscaling for Disaggregated LLM Serving with Token Velocity
why_it_matters: Token-velocity autoscaling of prefill and decode pools; convertible decoders absorb bursts locally.
limitation: Token-velocity signals need workload-shift and burst validation; predictive scaling does not remove worker startup/reconfiguration cost.

title: DualScale: Energy-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving via Phase-Aware Placement and DVFS
why_it_matters: Phase-aware placement and DVFS for prefill and decode pools; request KV retrieved by decode.
limitation: Formerly BiScale; phase-aware placement and DVFS are coupled, so isolate allocation changes from frequency savings.

title: Huawei Cloud Model-as-a-Service on the CloudMatrix384 SuperPod
why_it_matters: Production PD with attention-FFN disaggregated decode on CloudMatrix384; KV and activations cross.
limitation: First-party CloudMatrix384 deployment report; vendor fabric/shared-memory assumptions need separate validation on other platforms.

title: RTP-LLM: High-Performance Alibaba LLM Inference Engine
why_it_matters: Production prefill and decode nodes with tiered prefix cache; KV sent prefill to decode.
limitation: Production engine/report scope is broader than PD; pin the release and isolate phase, cache, and communication optimizations.

title: Prefill-Decode Disaggregation (PD)
why_it_matters: Documents gateway routing by prompt length to combined or PD rolesets; KV crosses via engine connectors.
limitation: Gateway routing and worker transfer are separate layers; use current supported engine contracts, not the relocated historical documentation URL.

title: Efficient Multi-round LLM Inference over Disaggregated Serving
why_it_matters: Multi-round prefills run locally on the bound decode worker or remotely; KV crosses only for remote prefill.
limitation: Multi-round incremental prefill differs from stateless request replay; preserve turn dependencies and retained KV in evaluation.

title: Crossflow: Prefill-Decode Elasticity for Agentic LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Fixed P/D pools; selected prefills spill to the decode home, otherwise KV crosses via NIXL.
limitation: Uses revocable decode-side slack leases without changing worker roles; distinguish fast borrowing from sustained role reassignment.

title: PEARL: Adaptive Prefill-Decode Execution with Elasticity for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
why_it_matters: RL rollout workers switch between all-colocated and all-disaggregated modes on elastic events; KV crosses when split.
limitation: Agentic RL rollout and borrowed training GPUs are the evaluation context; batch/job throughput is not online-serving joint-SLO goodput.

title: Tropical: Enhancing SLO Attainment in Disaggregated LLM Serving via SLO-Aware Multiplexing
why_it_matters: Decode-side capacity multiplexes selected prefills; KV stays local or crosses the PD boundary per policy.
limitation: Archival DAC 2025 citation and later arXiv posting coexist; compare SLO-aware multiplexing with tuned static PD and chunked prefill.

title: CrossPool: Efficient Multi-LLM Serving for Cold MoE Models through KV-Cache and Weight Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Attention, non-FFN layers and shared KV in one GPU pool, FFN weights of many models in another; activations cross.
limitation: Cold multi-model MoE workloads and memory pooling differ from high-load single-model AFD; report model popularity and cache lifetime.

title: FastAFD: Open-Source Large-Scale Attention-FFN Disaggregation on Blackwell NVL72
why_it_matters: Disjoint attention and FFN GPU pools in one NVL72 domain; per-layer activations cross attention to FFN.
limitation: Serving prototype: measured steady-state decode after prefill, not online joint-SLO goodput; future heterogeneous-platform numbers are projections.

title: Toward Cost-Efficient Serving of Mixture-of-Experts with Asynchrony
why_it_matters: Attention on data-parallel GPUs, experts on separate EP GPUs; asynchronous per-layer activation exchange and scheduling.
limitation: Asynchrony and re-batching are the mechanism; verify independent pools and interface semantics before treating it as strict spatial AFD.

title: AFORE: Attention-FFN Disaggregation with Overlapped Reconfiguration of Experts
why_it_matters: Attention/routing and FFN/expert pools with overlapped expert reconfiguration; activations cross per layer and microbatch.
limitation: Expert migration overlap depends on the pipeline window, upcoming routing demand, and GPU transport; evaluate skew and migration costs separately.

title: OpScale: Operator-level Provisioning and Autoscaling for LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Per-operator replica pools provisioned and autoscaled; activations forwarded between operator stages.
limitation: Operator-level autoscaling requires allocation/placement/resharding accounting; a finer cut is not automatically profitable in every workload.

title: OpWeave: Flexible Operator Disaggregation for Heterogeneous LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Planner-chosen operator partitions on heterogeneous device groups; hidden states cross stage boundaries.
limitation: Planner-selected boundaries and hardware matching need comparison to independently tuned colocated and fixed-AFD plans.

title: FastDecode: High-Throughput GPU-Efficient LLM Serving using Heterogeneous Pipelines
why_it_matters: Decode attention and KV on remote CPU R-workers, other layers on GPU; Q/K/V and outputs cross per layer.
limitation: CPU/GPU attention splitting is sensitive to CPU service rate and communication; report the full heterogeneous pipeline budget.

title: Efficient Heterogeneous Large Language Model Decoding with Model-Attention Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Decode attention and KV on memory-optimized GPUs, other layers on compute GPUs; Q/K/V and outputs cross.
limitation: Core attention/KV is separated from the projection/FFN weight path; do not apply full-attention activation-size assumptions.

title: AiDE: Attention-FFN Disaggregated Execution for Cost-Effective LLM Decoding on CXL-PNM
why_it_matters: Decode attention and KV on CXL-PNM devices, projections and FFN on GPUs; Q/K/V and outputs cross per layer.
limitation: CXL-PNM offload has hardware-specific memory and interface constraints; compare the actual projection/core-attention split.

title: CHIME: A Case for Efficient Long-Context Attention-FC Disaggregated Inference with DIMM-PIM
why_it_matters: Decode attention and KV on DIMM-PIM, FC layers on GPUs; Q/K/V and attention outputs cross per layer.
limitation: DIMM-PIM assumptions and roofline predictions differ from a conventional GPU deployment; current CHIME and earlier L3 are one version family.

title: Glinthawk: A Two-Tiered Architecture for Offline LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Non-attention layers on high-end tier, attention and KV on lower-end tier; activations cross per layer.
limitation: Offline inference throughput is not equivalent to interactive TTFT/TPOT goodput; its two-tier attention offload has a distinct boundary.

title: Hetis: Serving LLMs in Heterogeneous GPU Clusters with Fine-grained and Dynamic Parallelism
why_it_matters: Lower-end GPUs compute offloaded decode attention heads; head-partitioned KV with per-layer activation exchange.
limitation: Head placement and heterogeneous parallelism require bandwidth/memory accounting beyond the count of GPUs.

title: HPU: High-Bandwidth Processing Unit for Scalable, Cost-effective LLM Inference via GPU Co-processing
why_it_matters: Generation-stage attention and KV on HPU cards, linear layers on GPU; vectors cross per layer.
limitation: Specialized co-processor evaluation does not establish drop-in performance on commodity GPU clusters.

title: Weaver: Efficient Multi-LLM Serving with Attention Offloading
why_it_matters: Attention of a hot model offloaded to colocated instances of other models; KV placed at prefill completion.
limitation: Attention borrowing among models changes co-tenant scheduling and cache placement; compare against matched multi-model workloads.

title: Heterogeneous LLM Serving with General-Purpose Processing-Near-Memory for Retrieval-Based Sparse Attention
why_it_matters: Decode attention over KV on PNM devices beside GPU nodes; queries and partial results cross per layer.
limitation: Retrieval-based sparse attention and a PNM hardware tier alter both the workload and the boundary; avoid transferring dense-attention results.

title: KernelFlume: Elastic Core-Attention Scaling for Agentic Long-Context Decoding
why_it_matters: Core attention over KV on elastic weightless attention nodes; per-step queries and partial outputs cross.
limitation: Separates core attention from projections/FFN; larger-model and cheaper-hardware results include simulation, not only the live 8B testbeds.

title: NELSSA: A GPU-PNM Heterogeneous System for Mixed-Length LLM Serving via Length-based Request Placement
why_it_matters: Long-request clustered KV and sparse attention on PNM node beside decode GPUs; centroids and partials cross.
limitation: Mixed-length placement on PNM hardware must be evaluated alongside attention quality and real interface bandwidth.

title: Serving Hybrid LLM Loads with SLO Guarantees Using CPU-GPU Attention Piggybacking
why_it_matters: Best-effort decode attention piggybacked onto host and remote CPUs; KV swapped to CPU memory.
limitation: Borrowed CPU attention for best-effort work must preserve the latency-sensitive co-tenant SLO; record CPU/network use.

title: Expert-as-a-Service: Towards Efficient, Scalable, and Robust Large-scale MoE Serving
why_it_matters: Experts run as an independently scaled service; token activations cross to experts and back per layer.
limitation: A remote expert service is a narrower boundary than a full dense attention/FFN split; include dispatch/combine and failure semantics.

title: Remoe: Towards Efficient and Low-Cost MoE Inference in Serverless Computing
why_it_matters: Non-expert layers in a main serverless function, remote experts in separate functions; hidden states cross.
limitation: Serverless function placement and parameter caching dominate a different cost model from always-on GPU AFD.

title: FaaSMoE: A Serverless Framework for Multi-Tenant Mixture-of-Experts Serving
why_it_matters: Expert blocks served as serverless functions for many tenants; token batches cross to experts and back.
limitation: Multi-tenant serverless experts require cold-start, parameter residency, and request isolation accounting.

title: Making MoE-based LLM Inference Resilient with Tarragon
why_it_matters: Attention and expert workers separated with KV checkpointing; failures recovered on either side.
limitation: Recovery independence is a separate property from structural AFD; include checkpoint/replica cost and failure-free performance.

title: ASAP: A Disaggregated and Asynchronous Inference System for MoE Prefill
why_it_matters: Prefill-phase attention and MoE on disjoint NPU pools; hidden states and expert outputs cross per layer.
limitation: Targets asynchronous MoE prefill on NPUs; TTFT evidence must not be presented as decode TPOT or GPU AFD evidence.

title: Announcing vLLM AFD Plugin: Disaggregating Attention and FFN for Flexible MoE Serving
why_it_matters: Attention and FFN services on disjoint Ascend dies; per-layer activations cross split layers.
limitation: Experimental plugin with version- and connector-specific recipes; controlled forced-balancing benchmarks can alter outputs and do not establish production accuracy.

title: Energy-Efficient LLM Serving via Disaggregated Attention--FFN and Flexible Frequency Scaling
why_it_matters: Four pools (prefill/decode x attention/FFN) with per-pool frequency; hidden states cross A/F, KV crosses P to D.
limitation: GPU-only energy on A800/Qwen3/Mixtral and P90 latency; gains combine provisioning, TP layout, pipelines, and DVFS, so isolate their contributions.

title: ExpertPlex: A High-Goodput Disaggregated Serving System for MoE LLMs with Adaptive Persistent Kernels
why_it_matters: Prefill-attention and decode-attention servers share MoE servers; routed activations cross via persistent-kernel buffers.
limitation: Shares expert computation across prefill/decode while splitting attention; persistent-kernel isolation and weight-sharing gains should be ablated.

title: HexGen-3: A Fully Disaggregated LLM Serving Framework with Fine-Grained Heterogeneous Resource Autoscaling
why_it_matters: Separate prefill, attention and FFN pools on heterogeneous GPUs; KV crosses P to A, activations cross A to F.
limitation: Composite phase/operator provisioning adds multiple handoffs; verify each state contract and include reconfiguration overhead.

title: ElasticMM: Efficient Multimodal LLMs Serving with Elastic Multimodal Parallelism
why_it_matters: Encode, prefill and decode stages per modality group with elastic instances; vision tokens and KV cross stages.
limitation: Modality groups, encoder throughput, and stage-specific parallelism add dimensions beyond text-only PD.

title: Nova: Real-Time Agentic Vision-Language Model Serving with Adaptive Cross-Stage Parallelization
why_it_matters: Vision encode, prefill and decode workers on SM partitions of one GPU; requests cross via queues.
limitation: Single-GPU SM partitioning is a logical stage separation with shared-device contention, not an inter-node EPD deployment.

title: TriInfer: Hybrid EPD Disaggregation for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
why_it_matters: Hybrid E, P, D and combined instances; image cache crosses E to P, KV crosses P to D.
limitation: Use the MLSys 2026 canonical version; hybrid multimodal stage allocation and P90 SLOs differ from text-only throughput comparisons.

title: Enabling Disaggregated Multi-Stage MLLM Inference via GPU-Internal Scheduling and Resource Sharing
why_it_matters: Preprocess, encode+prefill and decode workers share GPUs; embeddings and KV read in place via IPC.
limitation: GPU-internal sharing uses in-place state access; measure preprocessing and encode cost rather than treating all TTFT as prefill.

title: PowerSlider: Exploiting Phase Asymmetry for LLM Serving under Demand Response
why_it_matters: Prefill, think and answer stage pools with per-pool frequency; KV crosses between stage pools.
limitation: Demand-response power caps are an instantaneous constraint; disclose priority policy, quality, tail latency, and energy measurement scope.

title: Not All Prefills Are Equal: PPD Disaggregation for Multi-turn LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Multi-turn append-prefills run on prefill-capable decode, full prefills on P; KV crosses one way.
limitation: Append-prefill locality helps multi-turn requests; retain actual prefix reuse and compare TTFT against decode interference.

title: BestServe: Serving Strategies with Optimal Goodput in Collocation and Disaggregation Architectures
why_it_matters: Analytical optimizer ranks collocated versus disaggregated configurations; KV handoff modelled.
limitation: Simulator/roofline ranking requires held-out live-system accuracy; an optimal modeled plan need not be optimal on a new runtime.

title: MIST: A Co-Design Framework for Heterogeneous, Multi-Stage LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Simulated co-design of hardware, parallelism and chunked versus disaggregated batching; KV transfer modelled.
limitation: Co-design/simulation assumptions about hardware and stages require calibration; distinguish modeled crossover from measured end-to-end wins.

title: AIConfigurator: Lightning-Fast Configuration Optimization for Multi-Framework LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Offline search over aggregated and xPyD configurations with modelled per-phase latency; KV transfer folded into TTFT.
limitation: Configuration optimizer, not a serving runtime; freeze profiles/version compatibility and validate the returned plan on target hardware.

title: SARA: SLO-Aware Resource Allocation for Disaggregated Agentic LLM Services
why_it_matters: Analytical SLO-aware sizing of prefill and decode pools; KV transfer modelled.
limitation: Analytical allocation depends on workload/queueing assumptions and state costs; validate against target-system tail SLOs.

title: Beyond Prefill-Decode Disaggregation: Dissecting LLM Inference for Heterogeneous Platforms via Dynamic Operator Scheduling
why_it_matters: Compares PD, AF and per-operator placements over NPU plus PIM sharing host memory.
limitation: Hardware-specific NPU/PIM scheduling and weight layout change multiple factors; compare cuts at matched layouts and budgets.

title: ECO: Energy-Oriented Configuration Optimization for Attention FFN Disaggregated LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Energy-oriented search over attention and FFN group sizes and settings; dispatch/combine data cross per layer.
limitation: Budgeted configuration search rather than an online autoscaler; compare search cost, frozen feasible outcomes, and measurement/quality boundaries.

title: Tessera: Unlocking Heterogeneous GPUs through Kernel-Granularity Disaggregation
why_it_matters: Kernel-level disaggregation across heterogeneous GPUs compared with PD and AF splits; intermediate buffers cross.
limitation: The current title is Tessera; kernel-granularity splitting is broader than PD or AFD and changes the runtime/planning problem.

title: When Does Disaggregation Pay? Simulating Prefill--Decode--Attention--FFN Specialization for Agentic LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Simulates colocated, PD, AF and four-way PDAF pools on heterogeneous hardware; crossings as byte counts.
limitation: Simulation of heterogeneous phase/operator combinations; disclose calibration and do not label projected configurations as deployments.

title: MemExplorer: Navigating the Heterogeneous Memory Design Space for Agentic Inference NPUs
why_it_matters: Memory design-space exploration for separately optimized prefill, decode, attention and FFN NPUs.
limitation: Memory-technology exploration for NPUs is architectural evidence rather than a ready GPU serving implementation.

title: TokenPowerBench: Benchmarking the Power Consumption of LLM Inference
why_it_matters: Provides inference power measurement and phase-aligned energy analysis relevant to disaggregated-serving evaluation.
limitation: Measurement methodology does not establish that PD/AFD saves energy; include node/network boundaries and attribution assumptions.

title: TokenPowerSandbox: Evidence-Gated CPU-First Screening for Energy-Aware LLM Serving
why_it_matters: Separates cheap configuration screening, target-GPU probes, and frozen validation with metric-specific abstention.
limitation: Single H100/Qwen2.5-7B evidence; no validation of multi-GPU transfer or PD/AFD architecture crossover, and energy accuracy does not certify latency.
